title: Ritual Beverage Continuity
description: Four reference-linked beverage heroes establishing a coherent ritual-driven campaign language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes vessel styling, tabletop texture, tonal mood, and camera distance. Images 02-04 preserve that exact ritual-centered system while rotating brewing action, drink type, and time-of-day energy.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-morning-bar-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
